title: Autumn Ghost

steps.heading: Get ready
paragraphs: Cover your table. Start with the preprinted ghost canvas. Keep the background white.
Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors.
steps.remainWhite: The ghost, bow, pumpkin, stem, cheeks, tongue and background

steps.heading: Paint the ghost
paragraphs: Use ivory for the ghost and both hands. Paint around the eyes, mouth and pumpkin.
Leave the bow, pumpkin, stem, cheeks and tongue white. Let the paint dry.
steps.remainWhite: Bow, pumpkin, stem, cheeks, tongue and background

steps.heading: Paint the bow
paragraphs: Use plum purple for the bow loops, knot and ribbon tails.
Use a small brush near the black lines. Let the bow dry.
steps.remainWhite: Pumpkin, stem, cheeks, tongue and background

steps.heading: Add the pumpkin
paragraphs: Paint the pumpkin orange. Follow each curved section from top to bottom.
Paint the stem olive green. Keep the ghost's hands ivory.

steps.heading: Finish the face
paragraphs: Paint the cheeks and tongue coral pink.
Use black for the eyes, eyebrows and mouth. Keep the tiny eye dots white. Lay the canvas flat to dry.
steps.newPaint: Coral-pink cheeks and tongue; black eyes, eyebrows and mouth

care: Use thin coats. Rinse your brush and pat it dry when you change colors. Let each color dry before painting beside it.
cleanup: Lay your canvas flat to dry. Wash your brushes and close the paint pots.
sourceNotes: The five panels condense original stages 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7 and the black facial finish from stage 11. The artwork uses the canonical region and line masks with flat ready-to-use colors. Fold shading, texture, highlights and mixing are omitted. The approved centered composition and square-to-portrait placement are unchanged. Instruction pictures retain dark teaching linework; the production transfer is the byte-identical approved gray SVG.
